g.text: Title: FPGA Hospital Monitor - sensor shield for the Cmod A7

g.desc: Title: FPGA Hospital Monitor - sensor shield for the Cmod A7

g.text: All signal processing is in the FPGA; this board only powers and connects the sensors.

g.desc: All signal processing is in the FPGA; this board only powers and connects the sensors.

g.text: Series resistor limits the FPGA pin current (LVCMOS33 ~12 mA).

g.desc: Series resistor limits the FPGA pin current (LVCMOS33 ~12 mA).

g.text: I2C pull-ups are on the module: set its jumper to 3.3 V

g.desc: I2C pull-ups are on the module: set its jumper to 3.3 V

g.text: the Cmod input divider needs ~250 uA. Same volts, more current.

g.desc: the Cmod input divider needs ~250 uA. Same volts, more current.

g.text: VU is the USB 5 V after a Schottky diode on the Cmod: about 4.7 V.

g.desc: VU is the USB 5 V after a Schottky diode on the Cmod: about 4.7 V.

g.text: LO-, LO+, SDN not used (SDN is pulled up on the breakout)

g.desc: LO-, LO+, SDN not used (SDN is pulled up on the breakout)

g.text: MCP1700 dropout is 0.18 V, so 3.3 V out is comfortable. Max 250 mA.

g.desc: MCP1700 dropout is 0.18 V, so 3.3 V out is comfortable. Max 250 mA.

g.text: Unity-gain buffer: the TMP36 can source only 50 uA,

g.desc: Unity-gain buffer: the TMP36 can source only 50 uA,

g.text: ECG and TEMP are 0-3.3 V analogue inputs; the Cmod divides them to 0-1 V for the XADC (VAUX4, VAUX12).

g.desc: ECG and TEMP are 0-3.3 V analogue inputs; the Cmod divides them to 0-1 V for the XADC (VAUX4, VAUX12).

g.text: Signals to the Cmod A7 DIP pins: BUZZER=1 SCL=2 SDA=3 ECG=15 TEMP=16 power: VU=24 GND=25

g.desc: Signals to the Cmod A7 DIP pins: BUZZER=1 SCL=2 SDA=3 ECG=15 TEMP=16 power: VU=24 GND=25
